source.description:
Current .xtrm/config/instructions/agents-top.md (~150 lines) has fluff and duplication. Propagates into CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md xtrm blocks.

Cuts proposed:
- GitNexus block duplicated 3x across CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/~/CLAUDE.md — pick canonical, link rest
- bd reference: keep ready/show/update --claim/close/remember; drop query/search/dep relate/dep tree/blocked/doctor/preflight (discoverable via --help)
- bv section: keep --robot-triage + TUI warning; drop metrics table, scoping examples, jq one-liners → ref XTRM-GUIDE.md
- Active Gates Memory row: compress 100+ word prose to one line
- Git Workflow block: drop, ref xt end --help
- Execution Interaction Policy: 4 bullets → 1 line 'Proceed by default; confirm only destructive ops'
- Quality Gates + Worktree sections: 1 line each or drop

Target: 150 → ~40 lines. Push detail to XTRM-GUIDE.md (already linked).

Source file: .xtrm/config/instructions/agents-top.md
Rebuild target files (CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md xtrm blocks) after edit.
